bio: A meal at l'Essentiel is an opportunity to explore an idyllic valley of the Namur countryside. A 17C tannery has been turned into an exquisite eatery dripping in cachet that boasts a romantic décor and a well-oiled front-of-house team. The establishment’s excellent value-for-money is another of its appeals. You should know that chef Raphaël Adam is nothing if not generous – you will have a choice of ten sorts of house-made bread, a huge cheese platter and a wickedly tempting lineup of fresh pastries to accompany your coffee at the end of the meal. Big-boned rich flavours are the hallmark if chef Adam, who likes to play on contrasts without ever overdoing it.
